inputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.constructor.runners
inputs.description: A record keyed by codex and claude that supplies the AgentRunner instances used by this service. Each value must provide discover() and run(); construction stores the record without invoking either method.

inputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.select.provider
inputs.description: The ProviderId key used to choose a stored runner and discover its state. The type permits only codex or claude.

inputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.select.model
inputs.description: The model identifier matched exactly against an entry in the selected runner's discovered models. Selection throws if no discovered model has this ID.

inputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.select.effort
inputs.description: The requested effort passed to validateModel for the selected model. Null or the empty string skips effort membership checking; any other truthy value must occur in that model's efforts.

outputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.list
outputs.description: Resolves to an array of each configured runner's ProviderState, in the order returned by Object.values(this.runners). The array length follows the configured record, and any rejected discover() call rejects the list operation.

outputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.select
outputs.description: Returns the stored AgentRunner for the selected provider after discover() reports it available and validateModel accepts the model and effort. The value is a runner instance, not the discovered state.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Runner discovery rejections propagate from list() or select(); select also throws when discovery reports an unavailable provider or model validation fails. Unavailable state uses state.reason ?? 'CLI unavailable.'; validation messages are 'The selected model is not available from this CLI.' and 'The selected model does not support this effort.'

outputs.name: ProviderDiscoveryService.list
outputs.description: Resolves to an array of each configured runner's ProviderState, in the order returned by Object.values(this.runners). The array length follows the configured record, and any rejected discover() call rejects the list operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Promise.all rejects if any runner's discover() rejects, and this method propagates the rejection without wrapping it. The rejection reason comes from that runner.
